candidateProfile.narrative: Anirudh Sharma is a full-stack engineer with 5.4 years of sustained GitHub activity across 40 original repositories spanning AI agents, infrastructure tooling, and web systems. He progressed rapidly from MLH Fellowship (2022) to enterprise software development at Konrad Group (2025) to a founding engineer role at a stealth AI startup (2026), demonstrating appetite for increasing ambiguity and zero-to-one building. His public work reveals compulsive technical exploration and strong documentation discipline, though testing and CI adoption remain minimal.

readiness.summary: Strong self-directed technical exploration (40 original repos, 31 unlisted projects) and willingness to join founding-engineer roles, but no evidence of platform ownership, cross-functional leadership, or organizational scope expansion inside companies. Proactivity is expressed through individual building, not through driving company-wide initiatives or undefined problem ownership.
